spec.name: Furniture Green Loveseat
spec.description: A compact two-seat sage loveseat with broad cushions, cream stitched piping, softly stepped arms and short walnut feet. Seat tops sit at y=14; the connected silhouette stays within the requested margins.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: two-seat sage green upholstered loveseat with cream piping, walnut feet and two broad seat cushions. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges. Seat cushion top must be at y=14 so a player can sit on it. Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
